passages.note: Prime sponsorship of a postpartum education and advisory-committee bill, which does not speak to who pays for coverage.

passages.provision_quote: The department shall identify and compile relevant educational materials and information for health care professionals and patients regarding maternal mental health conditions, including postpartum depression
passages.note: The enacted text mandates distribution of educational materials and creates a rural maternal-health advisory committee that reports and then repeals.
House final-reading Aye on HB2332; 13 of 60 recorded members voted no, so the tally is not near-unanimous.

rows.reasoning: The only evidence is HB2332 (2025), which Willoughby prime-sponsored and voted for: it directs the department to compile and distribute maternal mental health educational materials and creates a temporary rural obstetrics advisory committee. That is a public-health information mandate, not a position on whether government should "Make healthcare free and available to everyone, fully paid for by the public sector" or "Stay out of healthcare entirely and let private markets handle all coverage decisions" or anything between them, so no passage survives V2.
